data.gender_notes: Micheil is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Micheil is recorded in name-lists as “Who is like God?”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Micheil expresses “Who is like God?”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Micheil total 41, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
